text:
matt: Hey, seeing KV cache growth on long-context runs with PagedAttention on the H100 farm. Memory climbs continuously even after the active sequence drops, eviction counters not firing. cc @sophia @yuan
sophia: Ugh. Which runtime build and kernel selector? can you paste the pmap / page-table snapshot?
matt: runtime v2026.03.10, kernel-selector=v2. Trace snippet:```kvcache: page 0x7f9c.. resident=1 owner=slot=124 active=0 reuse_count=0 evict_count=0```
yuan: Does this reproduce on MI250x or only NVIDIA? last time we saw something similar it was nvlink-specific.
dave: I ran a quick repro with longctx=32768 tokens. PT shadow accumulates stale page entries; evict loop doesn't touch them. Perf counters: page_faults increases, evicts=0, reclaim_attempts=3 (stuck).
sophia: Could be a shadowmap sync bug on the remap/unmap path. Maybe fence ordering between the async pager and the tiled kernels. Can you try forcing host-side sync after each batch completion?
matt: Tried explicit host sync and a micro-sleep. Host sync alone didn't fully fix it; adding a 5ms sleep reduces growth significantly. points to a race in async eviction/completion.
yuan: Try flip: set async_eviction=false in config and re-run. If leak stops, it's almost certainly an ordering/race. Also test with kernel override to use linear kernels instead of tiled to rule out alignment-induced reuse-window skew.
matt: async_eviction=false reduces the leak (memory stabilizes) but throughput drops ~18%. Also noticed kernel override to linear made reuse_count increase steadily and eventually allowed eviction to reclaim pages. hypothesis: tiled kernel path shifts page alignments and causes PT entries to end up outside expected shadow buckets -> reuse policy misses them.
dave: I'll capture kvmem snapshot + GPU PTE bitmap at every 1k-token step across three runs: 1) H100 nvlink, 2) H100 PCIe, 3) MI250x. Diffing those should show where shadowmap vs actual PT diverge. Also running with kernel-selector=force-linear and force-tiled to compare.
grace-bot: deploy: test cluster h100-nvlink updated kernel-selector to v2.2 for matt's repro. run-id=2026-03-kv-7212
matt: I've opened GH issue #4921 with the repro script, perf traces, and the pte snapshots I have. Attaching a small repro that toggles async_eviction and kernel_selector and emits kvcache stats every 256 tokens.
sophia: Thanks. If this is a reuse-window->PT-bucket mismatch, we should add an assert in debug builds to validate shadowmap invariants on remap paths and a unit test that fuzzes page alignment shifts. Also add a metric for "shadow_not_found" when eviction can't find expected slot.
yuan: Agreed. I'll prototype a strict-mode that forces synchronous shadow updates for a short window to validate without changing production defaults.
matt: Thanks team — I'll paste the pte diffs once dave uploads them. For now, repro + mitigations in the GH issue. :thumbsup:
